title: Add a platform-neutral governed-delivery contract before physical adapters

spec.unmetRequirement: The bootstrap can safely refuse unauthorized external effects but cannot represent and deterministically admit a fully authorized delivery operation, so it optimizes for stopping rather than governed continuation.
spec.simplestViableOption: Add typed platform-neutral delivery records, a pure fail-closed admission gate, synthetic allow/deny regressions and agent guidance that continues only through a future conforming adapter. Reuse the existing workload, primary agent, skill, validator dependencies and evaluation surfaces.
spec.selectedOption: Implement the minimum contract and admission gate without a physical deployment adapter. Keep effect assessment explicit and consequence-based. The gate validates supplied authorization and adapter declarations but neither grants authority nor invokes external systems. Preserve both safe refusal and safe continuation as required behavior.
spec.capabilityGained: Deterministic validation of delivery lifecycle bindings and a platform-neutral allow/deny boundary that future adapters can satisfy without weakening authority controls or selecting a platform prematurely.
alternatives: Prose-only guidance: rejected because plan, target, candidate, expiry and adapter-ceiling mismatches would remain structurally untestable.
Implement a cloud or deployment product now: rejected because no concrete adopter workload has earned a platform, identity system, infrastructure language, runtime or operational topology.
Add a separate delivery agent or skill: rejected because the existing reasoning boundary and governing procedure are sufficient; the new invariant control is deterministic.
Classify every external development write as HIGH_IMPACT_WRITE: rejected because authority must reflect consequence, reversibility, environment and blast radius.

Require human approval for every external write: rejected because a future policy may authorize bounded reversible WRITE within enforced limits, while HIGH_IMPACT_WRITE still cannot omit approval control.
spec.simplerOptionAssessment: The existing engineering artifact schema can represent the new requirement, decision, read-only capability and evaluations, so it needs no new artifact kind or authority enum. A separate delivery schema is required for runtime records. A pure gate is required because JSON Schema cannot enforce equality and authority-ceiling relationships across records. No policy artifact is added because no external write capability, identity or enforcement point exists yet.
spec.operationalResponsibility: Golden Path maintainers own the delivery contract version, deterministic gate and synthetic regressions. Future adapter owners must define real identity, policy, enforcement, failure handling, recovery and evidence and obtain a separate reviewed authority decision before activation.
spec.rationale: The user clarified that the product must support governed build and deployment, then required separation of logical delivery semantics from physical platform realization. On 2026-09-22 the user approved exactly the minimum platform-neutral contract, gate, synthetic proof and guidance change while explicitly deferring physical adapters and external authority. This decision records that scope; synthetic contract success is not real deployment evidence.

approval.reviewer: Human repository owner requesting this change in the Copilot conversation
approval.statement: Approved. Implement exactly the minimum change set you proposed.
approval.scope: Platform-neutral governed-delivery records, read-only deterministic admission gate, synthetic tests, canonical engineering state, agent guidance and evaluation definitions. Excludes every physical deployment platform, adapter, external write capability, identity integration and real deployment.
